Data for 7,180 mainnet slots on 20 June 2026 (from `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node`):

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Total slots | 7,180 |
| Min arrival time | 141 ms |
| Max arrival time | 5,249 ms |
| Avg arrival time | 1,710 ms |
